summary.text: Gary Josephson is an independent write-in candidate for Ohio's 15th Congressional District. He was the Democratic nominee for the seat in 2022, losing to Mike Carey, and describes a long background as a union leader and community organizer.

paragraphs.text: Earned a bachelor's degree from Ohio State University in 1980.

In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, described himself as an activist for more than 50 years, with experience as a union representative, community activist and youth worker, and as president of CWA Local 4501.
Said he studied elections, legislation, environment, constitution, banking, arbitration and international human rights at the Ohio State University law school.
Finished fifth with 6.6% in the April 28, 2020 Democratic primary for Ohio House District 25.
Won the May 3, 2022 Democratic primary for Ohio's 15th District unopposed, then lost the November 8, 2022 general election to Mike Carey, 43.0% to 57.0%.
